title: see the hidden snow
description: ~ You can see the fluffy snow ~
body:
# ❄️ See the Hidden Snow
## The snow no longer hides traps—now it shimmers and reveals its true nature!

🌨️ Features:

A gradual transition from light, fluffy snow to dark, dense snow

A visual cue to prevent players from falling into dangerous snowdrifts

The winter atmosphere has become dynamic and lively

⚡ Why You Need It:

An easy way to spot dangerous areas

Adds realism and makes exploring winter biomes safer

A beautiful visual effect that brings the world to life

👉 Now snow isn’t just fluffy—it “breathes” and warns the player: be careful, don’t step into a trap! :3
